name: MIRA-CSI component-removal study
status: Frozen execution candidate; no new held-out scores have been inspected. Component effects are post-hoc follow-up to already observed original targets, not fresh confirmatory evidence.

variants.mira_full: Exact 20-channel reference architecture and coverage pool; can be rerun to check hardware/backend differences.
variants.no_mask_input: 20 channels retained; mask input is always zero. True mask still controls coverage pooling and distance still contains missingness information. NOT removal of all mask information.
variants.no_distance_input: 20 channels retained; distance input always zero; true mask input and coverage pooling retained.
variants.uniform_pool: Both mask and distance input retained; replace coverage-weighted pooling by unweighted mean.
variants.cnn_augmented: Original amplitude-only 18-channel augmented CNN comparator, 40423 parameters.
variants.resnet1d_augmented: Separate standard residual 1D CNN baseline, no architecture novelty claimed. Three blocks 64/128/128, each 7/5/3 convolutions, first conv stride2; GroupNorm/GELU; fixed 8-bin temporal pooling. Secondary source-selected comparator, not a MIRA component ablation.
variants.resnet1d_clean: Same fixed residual architecture without loss augmentation. Secondary candidate; select or compare only via source validation until explicit frozen evaluation.

parameter_control: All four 20-channel ControlledMIRA configurations have 40871 nominal trainable parameters and identical initialization at a given seed. Zeroed input channels have no data gradient; effective information availability intentionally differs.
training_augmentation: For cnn_augmented and mira_csi, each source-training sample is clean with probability 0.5; otherwise random/contiguous loss, fraction 0.1/0.3/0.5 and linear/nearest/source-mean imputer selected uniformly. Same draw order for the paired models at a given seed and fold.
split: Existing manifest unchanged. Per fold: source train 504, source validation 168, source familiar test 168, excluded environment 420. Participants disjoint within each fold.
normalization: Band mean/std computed only from source-training files, exactly as v0.1. Zero-log-amplitude floor and all other preprocessing unchanged.
selection: Minimum clean source-validation NLL; patience12, max60 epochs; no target metric influences fitting, early stopping, calibration, hyperparameters, or model family choice.
calibration: One scalar temperature per model/fold/training seed fit on clean source-validation logits, bounds 0.1 to 10; frozen on all test conditions.
evaluation: Default train-only; --evaluate is explicit opt-in. 31 conditions, full 5x5 training/mask grid per masked pattern/imputer. Preserve all probabilities and exact file indices. Smoke mode cannot evaluate either target or familiar test.
causality: Nearest-observed distance and repair remain bidirectional/offline. Do not substitute causal elapsed-since-previous observation within this ablation.
scope: Environment, participant cohort and LOS/NLOS vary jointly; no causal room-effect identification. No 60% target accuracy guarantee. New choices need an independent benchmark or untouched confirmation split for confirmatory novelty claims.
resume: Checkpoint each epoch including optimizer and NumPy/Torch RNG state, best weights and stale counter. Resume/completed skip verifies pinned protocol, code, input and final checkpoint hashes. Smoke outputs live in a separate subtree and never count as completed research fits.
pre_training_execution_fix: Before any new study/ResNet fit, replaced only ResNet AdaptiveAvgPool1d call by mathematically equivalent explicit floor/ceil mean bins to avoid nondeterministic CUDA-backward kernel. The MIRA quartet architecture and operators were not changed. CPU forward/backward equivalence verified; GPU runtime still must be checked.

smoke_provenance.note: The subsequent implementation-only fix affected the as-yet-untrained ResNet pooling call, not this smoke model. Smoke remains an execution diagnostic, not a completed study fit.
